metrics.tracking_rate: share of pieces followed to the end within tolerance
metrics.median_b: median absolute beat error, pooled over tracked pieces
metrics.mean_b: mean absolute beat error, pooled over tracked pieces
metrics.smoothness: mean SPARC smoothness across tracked pieces; higher is smoother
metrics.median_b_all: median absolute beat error over every piece
metrics.rtf: real-time factor: processing time / performance duration
metrics.estimated_bpm: given the performance tempo rather than only the score tempo
metrics.evaluation_key: hash of the conditions a row was scored under (fold, data files, scoring code, matchmaker sources, partitura); rows are only ranked under the current key of their input type

entries.name: Pitch HMM
entries.description: Pitch-only variant of the ACCompanion's HMM, without its inter-onset-interval term: score onsets and inserted states between them, with Bernoulli pitch observations. Matchmaker's default MIDI method.

entries.name: Symbolic tempo OLTW (parangonar)
entries.description: The tempo-tracking variant of parangonar's symbolic on-line time warping, which estimates a local tempo alongside the alignment.

entries.name: Online transformer matcher (parangonar)
entries.description: Transformer-based online note matcher from parangonar, combining a learned model with a symbolic alignment stage.

entries.name: Online pure transformer matcher (parangonar)
entries.description: Transformer-based online note matcher from parangonar, run without the additional symbolic alignment stage.

entries.name: Symbolic OLTW (parangonar)
entries.description: On-line time warping over symbolic note events, from the parangonar alignment library (https://github.com/sildater/parangonar). Matches one performed note at a time against the score note array.

entries.name: OLTW (Arzt)
entries.description: On-line time warping over an onset piano roll, aligning event by event.

entries.name: OLTW (Dixon)
entries.description: On-line time warping with a forward path constraint, aligning event by event.

entries.name: Pitch-IOI HMM
entries.description: Hidden Markov model combining pitch observations with inter-onset intervals and a Kalman tempo model.

entries.name: Outer-product HMM
entries.description: Outer-product HMM on CQT spectral-flux features.

entries.name: Outer-product HMM
entries.description: Outer-product HMM score follower, factorising the state space over score position and tempo.

entries.name: OLTW (Dixon)
entries.description: On-line time warping with a forward path constraint, on log-spectral energy features.

entries.name: Particle filter (Korzeniowski)
entries.description: The matchmaker team's particle filter, based on Korzeniowski et al. (2013). Tracks score position, note and local tempo, and rests, on spectral-template, onset and loudness features.

entries.name: OLTW (Arzt with Tempo)
entries.description: On-line time warping against a synthesised rendering of the score that is stretched by a tempo estimated from the backward path, on chroma features.

entries.name: OLTW (Arzt)
entries.description: On-line time warping against a synthesised rendering of the score, on chroma features.

entries.name: Switching Kalman filter
entries.description: Switching Kalman filter with hidden tempo, on raw spectrum features.

entries.name: Particle filter (Korzeniowski)
entries.description: The matchmaker team's particle filter, based on Korzeniowski et al. (2013) and extended to MIDI input. Tracks score position, note and local tempo, and rests, on pitch observations.

earlier_conditions.name: Pitch matcher (example)
earlier_conditions.description: Worked example. Matches each incoming note against the next few score chords and jumps the pointer to the first chord containing that pitch, interpolating at the tempo estimated from the last two matches in between. Naive on purpose — no durations, no recovery from a wrong jump.
